dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a well-established tradition that during Inazuman celebrations everyone's wearing festive masks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon tried to look around the stalls, but hasn't found any mask that fits...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you really want a mask of your own?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course! Not wearing a mask during an Inazuman festival is the same as not receiving a bouquet at the Windblume Festival...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me make one for you.

choices.text: Hmmm, I wonder what kind of mask will fit you best?
